title: Law to excuse TLC drivers helping disabled riders from tickets
summary: This bill would let taxi and for-hire vehicle drivers avoid stopping or standing tickets if they were briefly helping a passenger with impaired mobility get in or out of the vehicle. The defense would not apply if the driver blocked a fire hydrant, emergency vehicle, bus or bike lane, median, intersection or crosswalk, or stopped for more than 10 minutes. The law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
